title: Peer-reviewed study of 443,000 Backblaze hard drives ranks HGST most reliable and Toshiba the least Analysis of 1.66 million drive-years finds Seagate and Toshiba HDDs fail at roughly twice the rate of WD and HGST
summary: A peer-reviewed study of 443,000 Backblaze hard drives ranks HGST as the most reliable and Toshiba as the least reliable. The analysis of 1.66 million drive-years found Seagate and Toshiba HDDs fail at roughly twice the rate of WD and HGST. This study provides valuable insights for individuals and businesses choosing hard drives.
insight: Reliability matters in hard drive choices for data storage
